input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 (p0024) only allows a Party to stop the automatic one-year renewal on 90 days' notice at an anniversary; that is non-renewal (assessed under RENEWAL) and does not grant the Company any convenience exit during a term, so the fallback fails on the Customer convenience-termination element. Section 4.2(a) presupposes a Company termination but grants none, and imposes an uncapped Termination Payment (twelve months' Net Sales less $800,000, halved) that far exceeds three months of fees. We therefore add an express Company right to terminate for convenience on ninety (90) days' notice and cap the Termination Payment at three months of the fees payable by the Company under Section 3.1 (which is the Company's fee-payment provision: "The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month"). Read with the new Company-only right, HDI's 90-day right under Section 4.1 remains an end-of-term non-renewal right, satisfying the two Vendor-side fallback elements; the "if any" and quarterly instalment mechanics in Section 4.2(b)-(c) continue to operate against the capped amount. We have not pressed the preferred 30-day/pro-rata-refund package, which would require reworking the whole Section 4 bargain.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 4.1 only lets a Party stop the annual renewal, so we have added an express right for the Company to terminate for convenience on ninety (90) days' notice, and we have capped the Section 4.2(a) Termination Payment at three months of the fees payable by the Company under Section 3.1 in line with our fallback position on early-termination fees.

ops.text: The Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time, in whole or in part, upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to HDI.
